name: outer-outline_planar_probe_reflection
purpose: Verify the local planar reflection repro keeps the source monkey outline visible while the reflected outline remains bounded after the probe-capture outline suppression fix.
passCriteria: The copied blend asset opens in a factory-startup background session, renders with Eevee, and the top monkey keeps a strong red outline. The bottom reflected monkey also keeps a red outline, but the reflected outline must stay bounded and not balloon into a full-screen artifact.
